title: Lemon chickpea bowl
description: Bright, crisp and ready before the kettle cools.
steps: Rinse and drain the chickpeas. Dice the cucumber and roughly chop the parsley.
Whisk the lemon juice with the olive oil in a bowl.
Fold in the chickpeas, cucumber and parsley. Taste and serve.

title: Tomato skillet eggs
description: A warm, one-pan favourite for a quiet evening.
steps: Chop the tomatoes and finely slice the garlic.
Warm the oil in a skillet. Stir in the garlic and paprika, then add the tomatoes and simmer for 12 minutes.
Make four small wells, crack in the eggs and cover. Cook until the whites and yolks are set, then serve hot.

title: Smoky lentil soup
description: A generous pot, a handful of staples, a little comfort.
steps: Dice the onion and carrots. Warm the oil in a pot and soften the vegetables for 5 minutes.
Add the lentils, paprika and vegetable stock. Bring to a gentle boil.
Simmer for 25 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the lentils and carrots are tender.

title: Sesame mushroom noodles
description: A glossy tangle of noodles and golden mushrooms.
steps: Cook the noodles according to the packet, then drain.
Slice and pan-fry the mushrooms until golden, using a splash of water if needed.
Toss the noodles with the mushrooms, soy sauce and sesame oil. Finish with sliced spring onions.

title: Lemon herb couscous
description: Fluffy grains, plenty of herbs and a sunny finish.
steps: Pour the hot stock over the couscous, cover and leave for 5 minutes.
Fluff the couscous with a fork and stir in the olive oil.
Add lemon zest, lemon juice and chopped parsley. Mix and serve warm.

title: Roasted pepper toast
description: Crisp sourdough with a creamy, colourful topping.
steps: Drain and slice the roasted peppers.
Toast the bread until crisp and spread with ricotta.
Add the peppers, torn basil and black pepper. Serve immediately.
